Tree Maintenance & Pruning: Routine pruning, canopy shaping, and lopping of hazardous or oversized branches of all trees inside the campus as well as along the road adjacent to the o ffice boundary wall. Tree & Plant Replacement: Immediate removal and disposal of dead, dried, or damaged tree s and plants within the premises, followed by replacement with healthy, new saplings/plants of identical species and specification at zero extra cost. Monsoon Plantation Drive: Execution and maintenance of the 60-plant plantation drive durin g the monsoon season, including soil preparation, pitting, manuring, tree guard installation ( if required), and post-plantation care. Waste Disposal: Daily sweeping of fallen leaves, dry branches, and garden waste. Disposal must be executed strictly outside the campus to designated Municipal Corporation (JMC) du mping yards. 2. Tools, Equipment & Sprinkler System Provisions The contractor must provide and maintain all necessary tools, implements, and machinery in fully operational condition on-site at their own expense: 1. Automatic Lawn Mower (Petrol/Electric) – 1 Unit 2. Heavy-Duty Bush / Brush Cutter – 1 Unit 3. Garden Pipes & Sprinklers: Complete 03 sets of heavy-duty garden hose pipes (min. 100m) with multi-pattern nozzle sprayers and lawn sprinkler units. 4. Agricultural & Hand Tools: Pruning shears, secateurs, tree saws, loppers, spades, rakes, whe elbarrows, and chemical sprayers. Note: CGWB Jaipur will provide raw water points only. 3. Pre-Qualification & Eligibility Criteria for Bidders

Bidders must upload self-attested copies of the following mandatory documents during bid submis sion: 1. Financial Turnover: Minimum Average Annual Financial Turnover of above ₹10 Lakhs during the last 3 financial years (FY 2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26). CA certificate with UDIN mu st be submitted. 2. Income Tax Returns (ITR): Copies of ITR filings for the last 3 consecutive financial years. 3. Work Experience Certificate: Work Completion Certificates for similar Horticulture / Gardenin g Maintenance Services in Central/State Government Departments, PSUs, or Autonomous Bo dies. 4. ISO Certification: Valid ISO 9001 (Quality Management System) certificate to ensure complia nce with service quality standards. 5. Statutory Registrations: Valid GSTIN Certificate & PAN Card EPFO Registration Certificate ESIC Registration Certificate Labour Identification Number (LIN) Certificate 6. Local Presence: Proof of registered/functional office in Jaipur, Rajasthan. 4. EMD, Performance Security & Committee Inspection 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Bidders must submit EMD of 3% of the total bid value as per GeM provisions (unless exempted under Govt. rules). 2. Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG): The successful contractor shall submit an ePBG/Perfor mance Security equal to 3% of the contract value within 15 days of contract award. MSME Exemption: Micro & Small Enterprises (MSMEs) are exempted from submitting E MD upon providing a valid Udyam Registration Certificate. 3. Inspection & Rejection of Plants: All supplied plants, trees (including 8–10 ft Royal Palms and 60 Monsoon Drive plants), pots, manure, and grass will be strictly inspected by the Horticulture Inspection Comm ittee constituted by CGWB, Western Region, Jaipur. The committee reserves the right to reject any plants or materials not meeting quality standards, height, or health criteria. Rejected items must be replaced within 7 days at the contractor's cost. 5. Manpower & Post-Award Documentation 1. Mandatory Deployment: At least 02 (Two) unskilled/semi-skilled Gardeners (Malis) must be d eployed daily (5 days a week). 2. Supervision: The work must be supervised by either the Proprietor or 1 Skilled Supervisor po ssessing a Bachelor’s Degree (B.Sc.) in Agriculture/Horticulture. Proof of supervisor's inclusi on on the regular payroll of the contractor shall be provided during bid. 3. Worker Documentation Submission: Upon award of contract, the contractor must immediatel y submit complete list and identity documents (Aadhaar, ESIC/EPF numbers) of all workers a nd supervisors engaged to CGWB, WR, Jaipur office. 4. Workplace Liability: All legal, medical, and financial liabilities arising from any accident, injur y, or unforeseen incident involving workers lie 100% on the contractor. 6.
